backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC text and close-of-day OHLCV are known by signal date. Signal date is the first post-event T+1 close. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only SEC order/backlog demand evidence-span default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The SEC order/backlog demand evidence-span candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: SEC earnings-release text with concrete backlog, bookings, contract-award, customer-order, or RPO evidence, confirmed by T+1 SPY-relative strength, may identify demand-confirmation underreaction candidates for next-open 10d paper continuation.
interpretation: The SEC order/backlog demand evidence-span source did not clear Gate 4 and is not promoted.
next_retry_requires: backlog growth or book-to-bill magnitude extraction
contract duration and funding certainty extraction
shared helper plus daily snapshot parity for any positive replay

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping backlog, bookings, contract-award, RPO, T+1, ADV/price, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs materially richer PIT semantic provenance, such as extracted backlog growth rate, book-to-bill magnitude, contract duration/funding certainty, named customer importance, or forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily helper.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The SEC order/backlog demand evidence-span rule did not clear Gate 4. The likely reason is that backlog, bookings, contract award, and RPO language is either sparse, already reflected in the T+1 reaction, too generic across earnings releases, or not incremental to accepted SEC RS20 support after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: SEC earnings-release text with concrete backlog, bookings, contract-award, customer-order, or RPO evidence, confirmed by T+1 SPY-relative strength, may identify demand-confirmation underreaction candidates for next-open 10d paper continuation.

2_history_check.exp-20260603-012: SEC customer contract business-win candidate pool was rejected; this run requires earnings-release demand evidence plus T+1 confirmation rather than broad customer-contract item parsing.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-004: Accepted SEC financial-report RS20 notional support is the binding SEC comparator; this scout must beat EV +0.158184 and PnL +$3,235.38 before it matters.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-013: Rejected AI/data-center demand evidence span after positive but thin/concentrated results. This run tests orders/backlog demand evidence, not AI topic demand.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-015: Rejected forward-guidance quality evidence span; this run is not a guidance-threshold retry.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-011: Rejected restructuring/cost-reduction evidence span; this run targets externally validated demand rather than internal cost repair language.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and exp-20260614-004 SEC RS20 accepted comparator must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Free PIT SEC text can expose concrete demand confirmation that is distinct from recent Companyfacts quality, cost-reduction, guidance, and AI-topic text attempts. The main risk is that contract/backlog language is sparse, already priced by T+1, or fails the accepted SEC RS20 comparator after next-open execution and costs.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC text, evidence span, OHLCV, next open, or 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same SEC financial-report text set, order/backlog demand evidence-span extractor, T+1 reaction gate, liquidity gate, overlap exclusion, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

rejection_reason: aggregate_ev_not_positive; accepted_sec_rs20_ev_not_beaten; accepted_sec_rs20_pnl_not_beaten; window_ev_regression; fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows; target_sample_too_small; target_window_coverage_too_small; target_concentration_failed
